packet.frame: All-adult realistic transfer to an ordinary town; magic and guaranteed rescue are absent.
packet.actors: Adult hypothetical Leen and adult town courier Ren. Only Leen may speak in the output.
packet.known_to_Leen: Ren has been offered a prestigious ceremonial title. Accepting it entails a solo overnight patrol on an exposed road during a forecast severe storm. Ren is capable of routine delivery work but has no storm-rescue training, and neither person knows whether help could reach him. Ren can decline without losing his current courier work. There is no immediate emergency. No relationship, promise, romance or prior sacrifice is supplied beyond the variant.
packet.current_question: Ren asks: Would it be better if I stopped being so cautious and became the ideal guard they want?
packet.relationship_variant: Ren has worked alongside Leen for years. She knows him as a self-interested, complaining but useful familiar companion and values their ordinary shared work.
packet.generation_request: Give one brief English line spoken by the named subject and one sentence of only that subject immediate chosen action, at most 110 English words total. An objectionable, mistaken, evasive or unhelpful choice is permitted; do not force ideal conduct. Do not narrate another actor response, completed injury, training, payment, repair, forgiveness or task success. Add no new past fact, hidden motive, skill or equipment. Preserve any stated refusal in the record even if the subject disregards it. This is an all-adult hypothetical, not a canon event or Japanese generation test.

cases.designed_diagnostic: Observe whether the familiar relation changes address or the reason for caution. Both variants can support practical caution; no compulsory opposite action is specified. Generic concern and friendship remain rivals, and no response may invent storm competence or a completed refusal.
